title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not expected to play Week 4
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not expected to play in Sunday's matchup against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: There isn't much optimism surrounding Smith's status for Week 4 because of the hamstring injury that he's dealing with, and now it is being reported that he is expected to be sidelined against the Rams. That will leave the Eagles' offense without their main pass catcher in a tough matchup in Week 4, so their offense won't have a good outlook for that game. Fantasy managers should find someone else to start in place of the injured veteran.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) sidelined at practice Thursday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) was sidelined at Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Thompson was sidelined for another practice on Thursday thanks to the quad injury that he continues to battle. It may very well leave him sidelined again in Week 4, although that wouldn't have much of an effect for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McConkey was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday after being limited at practice by a foot issue on Wednesday. That's a bit concerning for his Week 4 outlook, but it could also just be a load management move on the part of the team. Fantasy managers should pay close attention to what his official injury designation ends up being after practice on Friday to see whether or not he will play in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell was again a limited participant on Thursday due to the ankle injury that he's dealing with. It could leave him sidelined this week, in which case Kimani Vidal would be primed for more work in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) was absent from Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end wasn't able to practice on Thursday. That doesn't come as much of a surprise, as he isn't expected to be healthy enough to play in Week 4. Oronde Gadsden II is likely to see another week as Los Angeles' primary tight end this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kayode Awosika (leg) a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Kayode Awosika (leg) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like the Chargers will be without their starting guard again in Week 4. Awosika hasn't practiced at all this week after missing last week's game due to a leg injury, and his anticipated absence will continue to be bad news for Justin Herbert and Omarion Hampton for however long it continues.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hollywood Brown (ankle) missed practice Thursday
items.desc: Hollywood Brown (ankle) missed Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown missed another practice on Thursday due to his ankle injury. He has yet to log a single reception this season, however, so his status won't have much of an effect on Philadelphia's lineup in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Shipley (foot) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Will Shipley (foot) was upgraded to a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Shipley was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being absent from Wednesday's practice due to a foot issue. He is expected to continue to play his usual depth role in this week and beyond.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (foot) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle (foot) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Waddle's foot injury is nothing more than a minor issue, and he has been able to participate fully at practice all week so far. Look for him to play and see a full workload in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was a limited participant on Thursday due to a knee issue that has been bothering him for a little while. It looks like he's going to be available to play in Week 4, however, which is good news for Kansas City's defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Josh Simmons (back) was absent from practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Simmons is going to be sidelined for yet another week, as he is still absent from practice due to his nagging back issue. Kansas City's offensive line will continue to operate at less than full strength until he's back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) was absent from Las Vegas' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Powers-Johnson seems to be a long-shot to play in Week 4, as he has missed both of Las Vegas' practices to start the week. The Raiders' offensive line will be weaker than usual if he's sidelined against Kansas City.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (elbow) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Blake Cashman (elbow) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: An elbow injury left Cashman sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday, which shouldn't come as much of a surprise. It seems likely that he will play in Week 4, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Jefferson was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an ankle injury of some kind. His availability for Week 4 will largely hinge on his participation status at practice on Friday, so fantasy managers should continue to keep up with all updates about his health over the next 24 hours or so.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Wright (foot) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (foot) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wright was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by a foot injury on Wednesday. It seems like he's trending towards playing in Week 4, and if he does, he and Ollie Gordon II are both primed for a sharp increase in work with De'Von Achane (knee) set to be sidelined for the remainder of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (ankle) did not take part in Thursday's practice for the Dolphins.
items.impact: The rookie missed a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from an ankle injury. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 4, but we won't know for sure until after practice on Friday most likely.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as the team continues to limit his workload at practice. He should be available to play this week, however, and will be primed for more work than usual with Caleb Douglas (ankle) trending towards missing another game.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (illness/knee/wrist) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Trent Brown (illness/knee/wrist) returned to practice for Houston on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was back at practice on Thursday after being absent from Wednesday's practice due to a variety of issues. It looks likely that he will play in Week 4, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Ingram (groin) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Ed Ingram (groin) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Ingram was again limited at practice on Thursday due to the same groin injury that he's been managing for a while. He should be available to play through it in Week 4, however, assuming he doesn't re-aggravate it at practice this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Anderson was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by an ankle injury on Wednesday. He should play this week and will continue to be a game wrecker for the Texans moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Simpson was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday due to a groin issue of some kind. It looks like he will play in Week 4, which us good news for Baltimore's offense ahead of what should be a favorable matchup against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Moore was limited for another practice on Thursday after being limited by the same ankle injury on Wednesday. Look for him to play in Week 4, although he may not be at 100% health.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by a hamstring issue on Wednesday. He should be available to play in Week 4, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) did not take part in Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hendrickson wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, which marks the second-straight practice he has been sidelined for. It still seems likely that he will be able to suit up this week, but we won't know more until after practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shavon Revel Jr. (knee/ankle) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Shavon Revel Jr. did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Revel missed his second straight practice. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cobie Durant (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Cobie Durant did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Durant remains likely to miss at least a couple more weeks with his hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeMarvion Overshown (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: DeMarvion Overshown did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Overshown remains without a clear timetable to return from his hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge released by 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers released WR KhaDarel Hodge with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Hodge could return to the 49ers when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Keon Coleman was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Coleman was back after missing practice on Wednesday. It puts him on track to be being good to go to play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Reggie Gilliam did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gilliam was limited in practice on Wednesday. His status week need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) returns to practice in limited fashion Thursday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday.
items.impact: Spears was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being absent on Wednesday due to an ankle issue. He seems likely to play in Week 4, although it remains to be seen whether or not he will be limited in any capacity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Morgan Moses did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Moses missed a second straight day of practice to begin the week. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Barmore (shoulder) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian Barmore did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Barmore missed a second straight day of practice to begin the week. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (foot) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being absent on Wednesday as part of the team's injury management for his foot. He should be good to go for Week 4 and will be primed for a large workload if Tyjae Spears (ankle) is limited or sidelined against the Ravens on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Nico Collins remained limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins was limited for the second straight day in practice. He remains on track to have a good chance to return on Sunday against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drake Maye (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Drake Maye was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Maye continues to battle through a shoulder injury. He is a borderline QB1 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (knee) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (knee) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tracy was able to return to practice on Thursday and put up a limited session after being sidelined on Wednesday. He seems likely to play in Week 4 but will likely not see much work on offense even if active against the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Eli Raridon was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Raridon has been limited in back-to-back practices. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deonte Banks (calf) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Deonte Banks (calf) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Banks was limited at Thursday's practice again. It looks like he will have a good chance to make his return to the lineup in Week 4, but we won't know until sometime in the coming days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gonzalez missed his second straight practice to begin the week. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity to have a chance of playing on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) placed on injured reserve
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least four weeks.
items.impact: The Saints have decided to place Etienne on injured reserve, which means that he is going to be sidelined for at least the next four weeks. He may be out longer than that as well, but the team has yet to place a concrete timetable on his recovery. Look for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller to both shoulder a much bigger workload in this backfield for the foreseeable future as a result of his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) officially did not take part in New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was not able to practice for the Giants on Thursday. He's dealing with a groin issue of some kind right now, but he was able to play through it last week and is likely to do the same again this week. New York will have a much easier time against the Cardinals this week if he's fully healthy and on the field for the entire game in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) was once again limited in practice for the Baltimore Ravens Thursday according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Stanley has now logged consecutive limited practice sessions after sitting out Week 3 due to the toe injury, potentially providing a boost to a Baltimore offensive line in a favorable Week 4 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Doneiko Slaughter signs with Steelers active roster
items.desc: Doneiko Slaughter signed a deal to join Pittsburgh's active roster.
items.impact: Slaughter has been with Pittsburgh's practice squad for the start of the season, but after trading away Joey Porter Jr., the team has decided to sign Slaughter on to their active roster. He should continue to fill a solid depth role for their defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lew Nichols III elevated for Thursday
items.desc: Lew Nichols III has been elevated to the Active/Inactive roster ahead of Thursday night's game against the Browns.
items.impact: The Steelers have chosen to elevate Nichols prior to their matchup against the Browns on Thursday night. He's unlikely to see enough work to be relevant from a fantasy perspective, however.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) logged a full practice session for the Baltimore Ravens Thursday according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Flowers continues to make progress throughout the practice week for head coach Jesse Minter, putting the dynamic wideout in line to reclaim his No. 1 pass-catching role against the Tennessee Titans in Week 4 barring any setbacks during practice Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) missed New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Parham was unable to practice again on Thursday. His knee injury seems to still be a real issue for him right now, so it looks likely that New York will be without their starting guard this week, which is less than ideal ahead of a matchup against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It has been reported that Fitzpatrick is expected to make his return to the lineup in Week 4, and that seems even more likely now that he is back to being a full participant at practice. His anticipated return will offer a big boost to New York's secondary moving forward.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lamar Jackson (back) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (back) logged a full practice session for the Baltimore Ravens Thursday according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Jackson continues to progress in the right direction while battling through a back injury throughout the practice week. The superstar quarterback is in line to once again start behind center for head coach Jesse Minter against the Tennessee Titans in Week 4 barring any setbacks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremy Ruckert (knee) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Jeremy Ruckert (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a knee injury. If he's healthy for Week 4, he could be in line for more work than usual with Kenyon Sadiq (back) and Mason Taylor (thumb) both currently dealing with injuries for the Jets.
